ActivityProperties.description:
Optional values preserve the distinction between an omitted attribute and an explicit default.
Quantities retain the full lexical range of xs:integer; expressions and scripts are plain text.

applies_to.description:
Enforced when a value is set and reported as a diagnostic otherwise;
never a structural invariant of `ProjectData::validate`.

unit.description: Free label for `Number`, an ISO 4217 code for `Currency`.

AttributeDefinitionId.description: Stable identity of a custom attribute definition.

AttributeDeleteResolution.description: What to do when a definition in use is deleted.

oneOf.description: Move the values onto another definition of the same type.

AttributeTarget.description: One element family a definition can apply to.

AttributeUpdateResolution.description:
What to do when an update would invalidate existing values (removed or
renamed enum option, narrowed `applies_to`).

AttributeValue.description:
A canonical, validated value. Numbers and currency amounts are decimal
strings as produced by [`parse_decimal`].

oneOf.description:
Reuses the dictionary targets so an imported label can stay an unlinked
literal (solution design §10.1); a list because RACI assigns several roles.

Axis.description: The axis the space tool works along.

Choreography.description: A choreography owns its participant and message-flow namespace.

ChoreographyActivity.description: An interaction task, a nested choreography scope, or a reusable choreography call.

Comment.description: Local plain-text annotation; `author` is descriptive, not authenticated.

verbs.description: Empty means the built-in English list.

rules.description: At most one entry per rule; a rule that is absent is off.

ConversationLink.description: A link joins a conversation node and a participant in the same collaboration.

ConversationNode.description: A conversation's participant references resolve in its collaboration.

DataPort.description: Activity-local input/output ports. Binding sets and unsupported expressions remain retained source.

DataStoreRef.description: Legacy local references serialize as strings; qualified references retain namespace identity.

DefinitionsExtension.description: An extension declaration on definitions; it is not a BPMN BaseElement.

DefinitionsImport.description: A BPMN import declaration; its location is model data and is never fetched.

DefinitionsMetadata.description: Attributes of the BPMN definitions element. Optional fields preserve XML omission.

DefinitionsRelationship.description: An inert relationship between QName-addressed model elements.

DiElementMetadata.description: Inherited DI DiagramElement payload (not semantic BPMN BaseElement metadata).

DictionaryEntryId.description: Stable identity of a dictionary entry.

DocumentId.description: Stable identity of a document within a project.

ElementIdentity.description: Persistent element identity; legacy XML IDs remain serialized as strings.

ElementSelector.description: A native or legacy selector. External XML QNames are separate model values.

EventDefinition.description: Event definitions are modeled explicitly; unsupported variants stay preserved source.

EventResource.description: Typed, document-owned BPMN root declarations referenced by events.

Expression.description: A plain legacy expression or a text expression with its BPMN metadata.

namespaces.description: Effective namespace bindings; the empty prefix denotes the default namespace.

FlowContainer.description: A subprocess-owned scope; its owner is the containing node, not a synthetic process.

ImplicitInputAssociation.description: Input association nested in an implicit event; its owner is its containing event.

child_lane_set_name.description: tLaneSet@name of the child lane set.

partition_element.description: tLane `partitionElement` child (an inline BaseElement), written before the flow node refs.

LayoutMetrics.description:
Measured quality of the proposed geometry. `overlaps` counts labels touching
labels or nodes and route segments passing over labels or nodes.

warnings.description: Counted quality defects of an otherwise valid proposal (one per code).

LoopCharacteristics.description: Qualified simple-text loop characteristics. Unsupported BPMN loop fields remain retained source.

oneOf.description: Whole-value setter of the modeling conventions profile; `None` switches every rule off.
Connect two shown elements with the flow kind the BPMN rules pick (see `modeling::connect`).
Append an auto-placed node connected from `source_id` (see `modeling::append`).
Replace a node or sequence flow with another BPMN type in place (see `replace::replace`).

Move shapes as one gesture with the bpmn-js move behaviors (see `manipulate::move_elements`):
boundary events follow their host, attach/detach, lane membership, scope change, and, with
`flow_id`/`edge_id`, insertion into the sequence flow under a single moved node.
Resize a shape under the bpmn-js resize rules (see `manipulate::resize`).
Give a flow a new source and/or target, keeping its ID and kind (see `manipulate::reconnect`).

Create an element at a drop point with the bpmn-js create behaviors (see
`manipulate::create_at`): scope and lane from the point, attach, drop on flow.
Add a lane above or below a lane or pool (see `containers::add_lane`).
Split a lane or pool into `count` even lanes (see `containers::split_lane`).
Create a pool, wrapping a process diagram's content (see `containers::create_pool`).
Collapse or expand a subprocess (see `containers::toggle_collapse`).

Insert (positive `delta`) or remove space at a line (see `containers::make_space`); the
shapes after the line move, or those before it with `before`.

at.description: Drag start: inside a pool, only that pool makes space (whole diagram otherwise).

oneOf.description: Align shapes left/center/right/top/middle/bottom (see `arrange::prepare_align`).
Distribute shapes evenly (see `arrange::prepare_distribute`).

Copy elements of a diagram and paste them moved by `dx`/`dy` with fresh IDs, into
`target_diagram_id` (default: the same diagram) (see `clipboard::copy` and `paste`).

NativeElementId.description: Stable native identity of a BPMN element or representation.

QNameRef.description: Expanded XML QName; prefix spelling is not semantic identity.

ReplaceTarget.description: What an element can be replaced with (bpmn-js replace menu entries).

oneOf.description:
A flow node, data reference type: `kind` plus the event definition type (`trigger`, none
for a blank event), non-interrupting boundary/event-subprocess start, event subprocess
(a subprocess triggered by event), and collapsed subprocess.
Plain sequence flow: no condition, not the source's default.
The source's default flow, without condition.
A sequence flow with an (empty) condition expression.

Trigger.description: Event definition type of an event replace target.

XmlId.description: An XML NCName, preserved exactly as supplied.
